column3: (Storable but Non-Cacheable Content) — Cache-Control here comes from vite preview, not Cloudflare; not representative of production headers.
(Base64 Disclosure) — heuristic match on base64-looking strings in minified JS/CSS bundles; false-positive prone, not an actual secret leak.
(Timestamp Disclosure - Unix) — a numeric literal in a bundled third-party library, not an application-controlled timestamp.
(Modern Web Application) — informational only; confirms the app is an SPA, not a finding to act on.
(Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy Header Missing or Invalid) — COEP require-corp would block the cross-origin SoundCloud iframe embed, and a static site with no private data gains nothing from isolation.
(Sec-Fetch-Dest Header is Missing) — this is a request header the browser sends; not something the server can set.
